welcomeDescription: Let's set up your language, AI provider, and first knowledge folder. This only takes a minute.
languageDescription: You can change this later from Settings.
providerDescription: Pick a provider and paste its API key. We'll verify the connection before saving.
connectionFailed: Connection failed — check the key or try again
sourceDescription: Point Nexa at a folder of notes, PDFs or docs. You can add more later.
indexingDescription: This can take a few minutes for large folders. You can continue and finish it in the background.
indexingNoSource: No folder was selected, so there is nothing to index yet.
doneDescription: Here is a summary of what we configured.
rerunDescription: Re-run the first-time setup to reconfigure language, provider and knowledge folder.
documentToolsDescription: Prepare the local Python environment used for advanced DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, and PDF workflows.
